name: io.github.swiftbotlabs/donecheck
title: donecheck
description: Ask before your agent says done: a paid Telegraph Miner checks the result. SUBMIT/FIX/HOLD + receipt

tools.name: done_check
tools.description: Call this BEFORE telling the user a task is finished. It checks the actual result against the task (a paid Telegraph Miner judges it on testnet; required strings are checked for free) and returns SUBMIT (finish), FIX (redo using the reason) or HOLD (ask the user), with a receipt.

result.description: What you produced. Task + result at most 2,000 characters.

mustInclude.description: Optional strings the result must contain.
